summary: The progressed lunation cycle describes a roughly 29-30 year life-phase rhythm formed by the progressed Moon and progressed Sun.
body: Use this as a slow life-cycle layer, not a daily transit. The phase describes where the person is in a long arc of endings, beginnings, risk, visibility, sharing, revision, and release.
definition: A progressed lunation phase is measured by the angular separation between the progressed Moon and progressed Sun, mapped as an eight-phase cycle across the chart angles.
appUsage: Use as a life-phase feature with multi-year timing, not a daily notification trigger.
Calculate the phase from progressed Moon to progressed Sun separation; do not infer it from age alone.
Anchor interpretive framing to the IC, Descendant, MC, and Ascendant wave described in the framework.
Pair with Saturn Return when timing overlaps: progressed lunation describes what is ripening emotionally, while Saturn Return asks what structure can hold it.
Keep language non-fatalistic. A phase describes developmental weather, not a guaranteed event.
note: Voiced from project-authored progressed lunation notes. Source file was not copied into the repository.

framework.anchor: The cycle is anchored to the IC, not 0 Aries. The eight phases map onto the chart's four angles as a wave: New Moon at the IC (bottom), First Quarter at the Descendant, Full Moon at the MC (top), Last Quarter at the Ascendant.
framework.houseProgression: New Moon = 4th, Crescent = 5th-6th, First Quarter = 7th-8th, Gibbous = 9th, Full Moon = 10th, Disseminating = 11th-12th, Last Quarter = 1st-3rd, Balsamic = end of the 3rd into a new cycle.

cycleFacts.rate: Progressed Moon moves about 13 degrees/year, progressed Sun about 1 degree/year; the Sun-Moon separation opens and closes over the full cycle.
cycleFacts.timing: Where you start depends on your natal lunar phase. Born near a New Moon, you hit your progressed New Moon in your mid-to-late twenties. Born near the Balsamic phase, you hit it early in life.
cycleFacts.note: This slow rhythm frames even long outer-planet transits. The progressed New Moon can land like an ending-and-renewal, close in feel to a heavy Pluto transit.

classes.relatedCycles: Pairs with saturn_return.json: the progressed lunar return (what makes you happy) often precedes the Saturn return's call to build on it.

phases.name: Progressed New Moon
phases.plainTranslation: Beginning and ending in the same breath. Something is over - a chapter, a job, an identity - and it can hurt. A seed goes in, but it is underground. You cannot see the new direction yet. The pull is home, roots, the quiet core.
phases.guidance: Do not force a direction. Let it stay murky. Go home, regroup, let the new self form before you name it.

phases.name: Progressed Crescent
phases.plainTranslation: Time to move, even blind. The dream needs first steps. Everything is new and the learning curve is steep - new job, new role, new person, all unfamiliar.
phases.guidance: Start anyway. Take the risk, then do the boring work. Take help. Stop overthinking it.

phases.name: Progressed First Quarter
phases.plainTranslation: A clean break. Independence, sometimes forced, usually through a test. Now you face other people - partners, rivals, the crowd. Weddings and divorces both cluster here.
phases.guidance: Take the risk. Pull in your allies. Face the judgment instead of dodging it.

phases.name: Progressed Gibbous
phases.plainTranslation: Everything grows - ambition, stakes, feelings, problems. Your horizons widen. You reach higher, climbing toward a peak. The trap is overdoing it: overwork, overspend, burn out.
phases.guidance: Invest hard, watch the excess. You are building toward delivery, not there yet.

phases.name: Progressed Full Moon
phases.plainTranslation: The peak. Climax or anti-climax - a win or a letdown, and both go public. Maximum visibility, maximum clarity. Separation runs strong: distance from home, the urge to shed the old.
phases.guidance: See it clearly. Take the result, spend the energy, set new targets once it settles.

phases.name: Progressed Disseminating
phases.plainTranslation: The turn toward home. Share what you got - teach it, give it back, fold it into the group. You find your people and your niche. Or you sit with a loss and work through it.
phases.guidance: Spread the harvest. Build the network. Carry the lesson into ordinary life. Do not slide into hiding.

phases.name: Progressed Last Quarter
phases.plainTranslation: A wake-up call. Back from the crowd to yourself. Hard questions: who am I, what do I want, what is still undone. The fear points forward - that you left it too late.
phases.guidance: Cut the distractions. Focus. Do the undone thing while there's time.

phases.name: Progressed Balsamic
phases.plainTranslation: The world gets quieter and more concentrated. Supports fall away, dreams get shelved, energy dips. It is the release, the closing, the last word. It can also be a late harvest - the reward you waited years for, landing now.
phases.guidance: Let go of what is holding you back. Say the unsaid. Find closure. Protect the small new seed. Rest, and get support if you are running on empty.

prohibitions: Do not use progressed lunation phase as a deterministic prediction of events.
Do not describe the Balsamic phase as failure, disappearance, or doom.
Do not use age alone when calculated progressions are available.
Do not collapse progressed lunation into ordinary New Moon or Full Moon ritual content.
weighting: Exact progressed Sun-Moon separation determines the phase.
Phase changes are multi-year thresholds and deserve stronger weight near phase boundaries.
Angular phases are louder: New Moon near IC, First Quarter near Descendant, Full Moon near MC, Last Quarter near Ascendant.
Natal lunar phase changes when a person reaches each progressed phase; personalize timing from the natal chart.

orbs.phaseRanges: Use the eight 45-degree phase bands supplied in classes.phases.degreeRange.
orbs.thresholdWindow: Give extra interpretive weight when the progressed Sun-Moon separation is within about 2 degrees of a phase boundary.
